I've successfully fixed the bug where `frai gate init --ci` was not creating the GitHub Actions workflow file. 

### The Problem
When running `node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js gate init --ci`, the `--ci` flag was being consumed by the root command's parser and not passed through to the underlying `frai-gate` CLI. This prevented the workflow file from being created.

### The Solution
I made two changes to `/packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`:

1. **Added `.enablePositionalOptions()` to the root program** (line 604) - This allows subcommands to handle options independently
2. **Added `.passThroughOptions()` to the gate command** (line 622) - This tells commander to pass through all options (including `--ci`) to the frai-gate process as arguments
